description:
Flexcompute is a cutting-edge technology startup that specializes in ultra-fast simulation technology. Our products are utilized by companies in designing and optimizing technology products, with applications ranging from designing airplanes and cars to wind turbines and quantum computing chips. Our customer base includes both household names and startups in emerging industries. Our company was founded by world-renowned leaders in simulation technology from Stanford University and MIT. Backed by top VC firms, we are poised to disrupt the billion-dollar engineering simulation industry with our fast-growing trajectory.
 We are seeking a hands-on software engineer to work on security projects across our web application, AWS, and on-premises high-performance computing environment. This is a crucial role in supporting the company’s growth into regulated industries.
 
 What you will do 
 Build and integrate technical security features and controls into our web application and internal administration platforms
 Implement and maintain AWS security controls, including IAM, encryption, backups, logging, monitoring, and alerting
 Securely orchestrate customer jobs and data across cloud and HPC environments
 Build and respond to alerts from security logs covering both cloud and on-premises hardware
 Deploy and manage vulnerability scanning tooling; collaborate with developers to triage and remediate findings
 Fix and validate remediations of penetration test findings
 Harden and secure on-premises HPC infrastructure
 Maintain and improve compliance tooling integrations, identify gaps, and drive remediation efforts
 Requirements 
 Strong hands-on engineering experience in at least one of:
 Backend software engineering
 DevOps / Infrastructure engineering
 Security engineering, with a focus on building than maintenance
 Experience securing cloud environments, ideally AWS
 Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform)
 Experience deploying or working with CI/CD pipelines
 Working knowledge of application and infrastructure security fundamentals
 Must be a US Citizen or Green Card Holder 
 
 What We're Looking For 
 We are looking for backend software engineers, devops engineers, or security engineers, as long as you are hands on and are interested in security. You will join a team of infrastructure engineers in an engineering-first company which is at the frontiers of HPC-based simulations. This is a role primarily focused on writing code.
 Ideally you have experience in one or more of: building NIST 800-171 or NIST 800-53, compliance automation platforms, infrastructure-as-code, AWS security, developing CI/CD pipelines
 Benefits 
 
 Competitive compensation with equity of a fast-growing startup.
 Medical, dental, and vision health insurance.
 401(k) Contribution.
 Gym allowance.
 Friendly, thoughtful, and intelligent coworkers.
